subject: The JB.AI Weekly #9: Why FAQ automation should come before sales automation

sections.mainTip:
## Main Tip: Automate Your Inbox Before Your Sales Funnel

Most small business owners rush to automate lead generation, but there is a faster win sitting right in your inbox.

- Your team is likely answering the same 8-10 questions every single day, which is time that could go elsewhere.
- FAQ automation reduces response time to seconds, and faster replies directly improve conversion rates without a single sales tool involved.
- According to [Tidio](https://www.tidio.com/blog/chatbot-statistics/), 62% of consumers prefer chatbots over waiting for a human agent for simple questions.
- Setting up a basic FAQ responder takes a few hours, not weeks, and requires no technical background.
- Start by logging every repeated question for one week, then build your automation around that actual list.
- Sales automation works better when customers already feel heard and informed before they even reach your funnel.

sections.spotlight:
**Why AI Bots Matter for Every Business**

Miss a call, miss a customer — it is that simple.

- Businesses miss up to 62% of incoming calls, losing thousands in potential revenue monthly
- AI Chatbots engage website visitors instantly, capturing leads at 2am as easily as 2pm
- AI Voice Bots answer, qualify, and route calls without hold times or voicemail
- Five hours saved weekly equals 260 hours annually — nearly seven full work weeks returned to your team
- That recovered time converts directly into growth, follow-up, and revenue

The businesses winning tomorrow are automating the basics today.
